# orly

> A turn-end gate for agent loops. Your goal becomes checkable specs; at the end of every
> turn one judge request checks them against the real files and command output, and the
> agent keeps working until they hold. `orly judge` exit 0 = may stop, 2 = not done.

## Use

- [Install](docs/install.txt): setup, the API key, where `.orly` lives, environment variables.
- [Writing specs](docs/specs.txt): specs that can be judged, file and command evidence, `orly specs`.
- [The guard](docs/guard.txt): what counts as weakening the gate and how it is refused.
- [Porting](docs/porting.txt): the CLI contract, `orly schema`, the Turn shape, writing an adapter.
